analyst_decisions_coherence_check.name: analyst_decisions_coherence_check
analyst_decisions_coherence_check.value: ("analyst_decisions"."status" = 'decided' and "analyst_decisions"."posture" is not null and "analyst_decisions"."cadence_minutes" is not null and "analyst_decisions"."entry_gate" is not null and "analyst_decisions"."risk_scale" is not null) or ("analyst_decisions"."status" = 'failed' and "analyst_decisions"."failure_code" is not null)

model_team_reports_decided_check.name: model_team_reports_decided_check
model_team_reports_decided_check.value: "model_team_reports"."status" <> 'decided' or ("model_team_reports"."action" is not null and "model_team_reports"."confidence" is not null and "model_team_reports"."roles" is not null)

model_team_reports_buy_levels_check.name: model_team_reports_buy_levels_check
model_team_reports_buy_levels_check.value: "model_team_reports"."action" is distinct from 'buy' or ("model_team_reports"."entry_price" is not null and "model_team_reports"."target_price" is not null and "model_team_reports"."stop_price" is not null and "model_team_reports"."stop_price" < "model_team_reports"."entry_price" and "model_team_reports"."entry_price" < "model_team_reports"."target_price")

model_team_reports_failure_code_check.name: model_team_reports_failure_code_check
model_team_reports_failure_code_check.value: "model_team_reports"."status" not in ('failed', 'skipped') or "model_team_reports"."failure_code" is not null

positions_closed_has_exit_check.name: positions_closed_has_exit_check
positions_closed_has_exit_check.value: "positions"."status" = 'open' or ("positions"."exit_price" is not null and "positions"."exit_fee" is not null and "positions"."net_profit" is not null and "positions"."exit_reason" is not null and "positions"."closed_candle_time" is not null)

runs_goal_outcome_needs_goal_check.name: runs_goal_outcome_needs_goal_check
runs_goal_outcome_needs_goal_check.value: "runs"."goal_outcome" is null or "runs"."goal_id" is not null

team_run_inputs_source_check.name: team_run_inputs_source_check
team_run_inputs_source_check.value: "team_run_inputs"."report_id" is not null or "team_run_inputs"."failure_code" is not null
